entries.speaker: Patrolman in Lab Coat
entries.en: Do not search for pain. Only tragedy[n]awaits you beyond here.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: All these warnings of pain and tragedy!

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Who is your Ruler? Why do you all[n]think you know so much about me!?

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: If you won't give me an answer, then[n]I'll just force my way through!
